_implementation_notes: VERMILION FILL -- Remaining Vermilion-area maps with game data available:
226 (Vermilion City alt layout), 394 (Fishing Guru house), 395 (Trade house),
463 (Vermilion Hotel lobby), 464 (Vermilion Hotel rooms),
155 (Route 11), 161 (Lighthouse), 546 (Fighting Arena).
Map 226: Alt Vermilion City layout. Many events are signs, locked doors, Easter eggs.
PRESERVED: Fan Club sign (E8), truck events (E10/E32/E33), locked doors (E14/E52),
city sign (E17), Move Experts sign (E29), Ice Preserve sign (E31), Pokemon cry (E24),
Trainer House NPC (E43 -- MECHANICAL), random Pokemon giver (E51), hotel sign (E45).
REWRITTEN: E18 (SS Anne NPC), E22 (pollution NPC), E23 (sea NPC), E48 (gym hint),
E50 (HM tip).
Map 394: Fishing Guru house. E3 (Old Rod gift) is MECHANICAL -- preserve entirely.
E2 (empty room) preserved.
Map 395: Trade house. E3 (Spearow-Farfetch'd trade) MECHANICAL -- preserved.
E5-6 (TV), E7-8 (window), E9 (type tip) -- light touch.
Map 463: Hotel lobby. E5 (rest mechanic) MECHANICAL -- preserved.
E10 (Balm Mushroom buyer) MECHANICAL. E11-12 (salon) MECHANICAL.
Map 464: Hotel rooms. E5 (Krabby legs quest) MECHANICAL.
E6 (TP challenge) MECHANICAL. E7 (Voltorb lighthouse quest) MECHANICAL.
E8 (Fire/Water type collector) MECHANICAL. E9 (empty room). E14 (boot quest) MECHANICAL.
Map 155: Route 11. Trainers + gamblers. Blackjack minigame is FULLY MECHANICAL.
Only modifying pre-battle lines (Page 0 idx=5) for flavor.
E10 (hidden money), E11 (cable NPC + trade) -- mostly MECHANICAL.
Map 161: Lighthouse. Voltorb beacon puzzle -- FULLY MECHANICAL. Light flavor only.
Map 546: Fighting Arena. Gym Leader rematches -- post-game content.
Battle triggers and choices PRESERVED. Only modifying personality text.
E36 (arena guide) and E59 (badge challenge NPC) -- light touch.
Spectator NPCs (E8-22): rewritten with Synthesis flavor.
NOTE: Maps 018 (Southern Gate), 020 (Pokemon Center), 021 (PokeMart),
022-023 (houses), 037 (Move Deleter), 061 (Gym rematch) are listed as
PLANNED/NOT_STARTED but have no dialogue data in wave3_dialogue.json.
They require separate game data extraction.
Tone: Militaristic, tense, port-city energy. Surge's presence looms.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP text box.
